Primaquine with clindamycin is used in the treatment of pneumocystis pneumonia as an alterna- tive to co-trimoxazole1 (see p.521). Treatment has usually lasted 3 weeks, with primaquine being given by mouth in daily doses equivalent to 30 mg of the base, and clindamycin usually being given intravenously in doses of 600 mg four times daily or 300 to 450 mg four times daily by mouth.2 The BNF suggests clin- damycin 600 mg by mouth every 8 hours with primaquine 30 mg daily by mouth for mild to moderate disease.
